description: Continue a pending file import, geometry inspection or visualization preparation using its operation_id. Poll at least the returned retry_after_seconds apart. On success, result contains the ready artifact, inspection or browser viewer link; continue the user's requested workflow. Show a ready viewer_url as a labelled browser link even when an image is also returned; a 2D picture does not replace an interactive 3D view. A disconnected chat does not cancel this work. Uses the original operation's permissions; never resubmit to check progress.
name: get_operation
title: Get operation status
